units: <cite ref="Pesachim 110b">Pes. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>דגָרְשָׁהּ לאיתתיה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דגרשא</he>, corr. acc.) who had divorced his wife.
<cite ref="Berakhot 56a:15">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>תרי נשי מְגָרְשׁת</he> it will be thy destiny to divorce two wives.
<cite ref="Arakhin 23a:38">Arakh. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>דלִיגָרֵש לדביתהו</he> that he should divorce &c.
<cite ref="Arakhin 23a:42">Ib.</cite> <he>אטו כל דמִגָרֵשׁ וכ׳</he> does every one who divorces his wife, give divorce in court?; a. fr.
<cite ref="Gittin 78a">Gitt. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>בת אי׳</he> in a fit condition to receive a letter of divorce.
